description: Ministry of Water Supply and Estate Infrastructure Development - Amendment Ext. Gaz. No.2220/10 dated 22.03.2021 (Ratwatta Watta) - Amended Ext. Gaz. No. 2150/24 dated 20.11.2019 (Galle Kandapathana)
reasoning: This gazette content primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the correction of land descriptions (extent, boundaries, and names) for two separate plots of land (Ratwatta Watta and Gollekandapathana). The content involves land registrations, boundary changes, and property descriptions, which are the defining characteristics of a Land Gazette (Type 4). While a government minister is named, the notice is not about government structure, personnel, or portfolio responsibilities, but rather about exercising statutory powers to correct land records.
